recentItems.title: "The Adaptation Makes Total Sense" The 'Carrie' Cast on Modernizing Stephen King's Iconic Story
recentItems.description:
Summer H. Howell, Samantha Sloyan, Amber Midthunder, Matthew Lillard, Josie Totah, Alison Thornton, Arthur Conti, and Joel Oulette sit down with Rotten Tomatoes correspondent Chris Tait to talk about their new Stephen King television adaptation, 'Carrie'!  Howell describes what it was like embodying the character of Carrie while avoiding watching iconic past performances, the cast shares what it was like working with an expert horror showrunner like Mike Flanagan, and they describe why an adaptation of this classic story is so pertinent for this generation.  Watch 'Carrie' on Prime Video now!
